comment: Vercel deployment config for TomorrowOS Onboarding. The build generates a prerendered index.html for every known route (via prerenderPlugin in vite.config.ts), so the router lets the filesystem serve those files directly. Only routes that intentionally have no prerendered file (SPA-only placeholders and the /quickstart redirect) are mapped explicitly. Unknown paths receive HTTP 404 so crawlers see a correct status and soft-404 crawl-budget waste is eliminated.

routes.comment: SPA-only routes: no prerendered file, serve the SPA shell with HTTP 200 so the React client handles them.
Moved 2026-08-05: the Blog index is now the TomorrowOS Journal at /journal.

Serve prerendered per-route HTML files and static assets directly from the filesystem. For every known route (/, /about, /guides/*, /learn/*, etc.) the build emits <route>/index.html with route-specific title, canonical, og:url, and JSON-LD baked in.
Unknown routes: return 404 with the SPA shell so the client renders the noindex 404 page.
